dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Relax, let me take the lead. I guarantee this commission— no, wait, this adventure! Yeah, this adventure will go without a hitch.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Though... Boss Nef did say to always have an escape plan...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: #Sooo, {NICKNAME}... Watch my back, yeah? If we need to turn tail and run, we run as one!
